card: Updates GNU binutils to version 2.47 within the Guix build environment. This keeps the reproducible release build toolchain up to date with upstream binutils releases. No specific bug fix or vulnerability is cited as motivating the upgrade.
problem: The Guix release build environment uses an older version of GNU binutils that misses recent upstream bug fixes and improvements.

risk.why: A toolchain regression in an updated binutils package could produce broken or miscompiled release binaries.

scope_notes: A minimal toolchain version bump in the Guix configuration (+2/-2 lines).
summary: Updates the binutils package to version 2.47 in the Guix build environment. This bumps the toolchain version used to produce deterministic release binaries.
